name: Honda Shadow 1100
engine: 1099 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, carbs, shaft drive
intro: Honda's long-running 1100 cruiser. Very durable. Charging parts and gummed carbs are the usual trouble.

add.title: Check the regulator/rectifier and stator plug
add.instructions: Measure battery voltage at idle and at 5,000 rpm. Look for a melted or brown stator connector and a scorched regulator. Clean and solder the connections if needed.
add.reason: Hot connectors and a failing regulator are a common way these bikes stop charging.

E: Grease the driveshaft splines when the rear wheel is out. Dry splines wear out.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Charging system
known.what: The regulator/rectifier and stator connector run hot and fail on many 1990s-2000s Hondas.
